course_summary:
ISEN 691 | Research | Summer 2026
Instructor: Thomas Ferris | tferris@tamu.edu
Meets: coordinated meetings each week | HF&CS lab
Grading: Midterm deliverable [30%], Final deliverable [50%], Weekly meeting attendance and updates [20%] — A: 90-100%, B: 80-89%, C: 70-79%, D: 60-69%, F: <60%
Topics: HF&CS lab members, Human Factors & Cognitive Systems (HF&CS) Lab, Rubberhand project team, mechanisms involved in human perception, reliably inducing human performance effects, experimental protocol design, IRB approval, human-subjects study, human subjects data collection, statistical testing, statistical analyses, journal article preparation, peer-reviewed publication, Introduction material, Methods material, Results material, Discussion material, literature collection, literature review, recruitment planning, recruitment, testing, data collection, results compilation, data analysis, results analysis, analysis finalization, results finalization, technical report writing, final research report writing, report refinement, report revision, technical results communication, lab presentations, project meetings, weekly check-in meetings, interdisciplinary collaboration, research project management, industrial engineering field, research
